title: Methanol-to-olefins (MTO / MTH) reference family
reaction: n CH3OH -> light olefins (C2= / C3= / C4=) + n H2O (zeolite-catalyzed via hydrocarbon-pool)
objective: Optional literature-backed family for methanol-to-olefins / methanol-to-hydrocarbon screening. Candidates compare a SAPO-34 chabazite anchor (the commercial DMTO/UOP-MTO benchmark) with HZSM-5 for shifted product selectivity and a Zn-modified ZSM-5 variant for aromatic-leaning conversion.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance catalyst cost, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported olefin selectivity.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward catalyst cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature support and more reproducible zeolite preparation routes.

citations.label: Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2006

citations.label: ChemCatChem 2009

citations.label: Microporous Mesoporous Mater. 2010

citations.label: Catal. Sci. Technol. 2011

citations.label: ACS Catal. 2015

route_templates.name: SAPO-34 chabazite MTO route
route_templates.route_note: Most transferable MTO basis matching the commercial DMTO / UOP-MTO process; SAPO-34 is the established light-olefin selective zeolite.

route_templates.name: H-ZSM-5 MTO route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: ZSM-5 zeolite catalyst preparation for MTH
route_templates.route_note: Mature H-ZSM-5 route; product slate skews toward heavier hydrocarbons / aromatics relative to SAPO-34.

route_templates.name: Zn-modified ZSM-5 MTO route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Zn-modified ZSM-5 for aromatic-leaning MTH conversion
route_templates.route_note: Zn-modified ZSM-5 shifts MTH selectivity toward aromatics; route adds an impregnation pass over the bare H-ZSM-5 baseline.

candidates.title: SAPO-34 chabazite (DMTO baseline)
candidates.summary: SAPO-34 chabazite zeolite catalyst, the commercial DMTO / UOP-MTO benchmark for light-olefin (ethylene + propylene) production from methanol.
decision_notes: Most transferable MTO basis and the dominant commercial light-olefin route.
Deactivation through coke remains the main process-side cost driver; high-pressure H2 co-feed mitigates lifetime loss.

pricing.note: SAPO-34 chabazite catalyst held on an engineering proxy in line with commercial DMTO catalyst pricing ranges.

candidates.title: H-ZSM-5 (MTH baseline)
candidates.summary: H-ZSM-5 (MFI) zeolite catalyst for methanol-to-hydrocarbon conversion, biased toward heavier hydrocarbons and aromatics relative to SAPO-34.
decision_notes: Use when the program target includes aromatic gasoline-range or methanol-to-aromatics products rather than light olefins.
MFI pore geometry favors C5+ relative to chabazite, with stronger Bronsted acidity.

pricing.note: H-ZSM-5 catalyst held on an engineering proxy comparable to commercial Mobil / Sinopec ZSM-5 pricing ranges.

candidates.title: Zn / ZSM-5 (aromatics-leaning)
candidates.summary: Zn-modified ZSM-5 catalyst for aromatic-leaning MTH conversion, used when the target slate is BTX-rich.
decision_notes: Use when the program goal is BTX or aromatic gasoline rather than light olefins.
Adding the Zn pass improves aromatic selectivity but increases catalyst cost and adds a deactivation pathway.

pricing.note: Live Zn feed with a precursor / conversion markup for ZSM-5 promoter loading.
H-ZSM-5 base zeolite cost held on the same engineering proxy as the unmodified candidate.
